name: Ghost
description: Ghost is a publishing platform for blogs, newsletters and paid memberships. Writers and small media teams use it to publish and to send each post by email.
licence_note: Free to self-host, also for commercial use.
whats_new: The first version of the template.
first_steps: Open the address of the app with /ghost at its end at once, and make the owner account: the first person who opens it becomes the owner. Ghost sends no email until you add the mail__ environment variables of a mail server (Environment, Add Variable).
